visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) A man with short dark hair, wearing a white crew-neck t-shirt and a cream-colored textured knit cardigan, sits on a light beige sofa. Behind him is a large white bookshelf densely packed with books of various colors. He holds a large, clear crystal-like candle jar with a faceted lid, smiling and speaking directly to the camera in a warmly lit living room. (2) The camera transitions to a close-up of a dark wooden dresser top. A hand places the large crystal candle jar onto the surface, followed by a text overlay. (3) The man is shown again from the chest up, holding the crystal candle and gesturing with his right hand while explaining its features. (4) A close-up shot features a different ceramic candle container decorated with a black-and-white graphic of a woman's face. The container has a gold-colored band around the middle and is placed on the dark wooden surface. (5) The man holds the ceramic face-design candle close to the camera, tilting it to show the interior wax while continuing to speak. (6) A brief cinematic scene shows a cozy indoor fireplace with a warm orange glow, surrounded by festive evergreen branches and wooden accents. (7) A third candle, a clear glass Diptyque jar with a ribbed glass dome cover, is placed on the wooden dresser. (8) A close-up shows a wooden match being struck and lighting the wick of the candle, followed by the glass dome being placed over it. (9) The man concludes the video, sitting on the sofa and gesturing toward the camera with a friendly smile.

He introduces his collection of scented candles over a steady acoustic pop background music track featuring an upbeat guitar rhythm. (2) A percussive thud occurs as a glass candle is set down on a hard surface. The BGM continues without interruption as the narrator details the scents of the first brand. (3) A similar thudding sound signifies the placement of the second candle. The speaker's pitch remains moderate and engaging, maintaining a steady flow of speech. (4) The sound of a match striking—a sharp frictional rasp—is followed by a soft crackle as the fire ignites the candle wick. (5) A final clinking sound of glass being placed over the candle is heard as the narrator asks the audience for their preferences and says goodbye.
